name: Download Salary Slip for Last Month
goal: User requests previous month's salary slip in Hinglish.
constraints: Bot should provide correct slip download link or attachment.

phases.description: User asks 'Pichle mahine ka salary slip bhej do'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides download link or attachment for May 2024 salary slip.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
